scope: Migration reference: physical item-owned destination payload survives save/load and is consumed by real action; not a player-clone whitelist or NBT variant quest implementation.
pin_limit: Existing fixed acquisition metadata and original candidate file SHA reused; no new official network/tree/archive fetch or independently rehashing deleted archive claimed. Helpers bound to same existing local source snapshot, not new blob proof.

mechanism.writer: Eye useOn secondary-use server branch encodes BlockPos via NbtOps and sets only target_+current dimension ID on physical stack; unrelated tag keys retained.
mechanism.reader: CoordBoundItemImpl reads only current-dimension tag and returns parsed position or null; missing/malformed is not default origin. Tooltip merely queries.
mechanism.consumer: finishUsingItem uses same dimension key; missing returns unchanged stack; invalid codec removes only that key then returns. Valid target drives distance*10 int cost, successful exact mana request precedes teleport to block centre+1.5Y; destination key retained for reuse. Non-player LivingEntity bypasses mana branch.
mechanism.payment: ManaItemHandlerImpl exact request scans inventory/offhand and accessories, excludes requestor object, builds ManaItem->int plan, debits only when sum exactly equals cost. No world move success receipt/refund/disk atomicity.
mechanism.separate_owner: RelicItem inventoryTick server calls tickBinding. RelicImpl string soulbindUUID parse failure removes UUID then subsequent tick may bind current player and trigger relic bind advancement. This generic binding is support, not separate reference. Eye useOn/finishUsingItem shown has no direct isRightPlayer guard; no claim wrong-player teleport prevented by parent damage.
mechanism.nontransferable: Location/paid travel and soulbind property are item state; neither proves which player crafted a four-NBT variant. Never use pickup/tooltip/rebinding as crafting history.

limits: Not native runtime, not Dynasty implementation or survival acceptance.
No explicit side guard in shown finishUsingItem; native callback side behavior not traced, do not infer server-only payment from source method alone.
No loaded-chunk/collision/safe-arrival check in shown consumer; cost debit and teleport not atomic.
Mana event/accessory implementations and BlockPos codec internals not traced; no claim negative/malformed-provider protection or duplicate-provider plan correctness.
Integer distance conversion has no explicit bounds here. Invalid location is deleted only by finish use; read tooltip returns null without deletion.
Generic RelicImpl UUID/advancement chain and Mana exact request are support only, not counted as additional families.

dedup_review.distinction_proposal: Item-local map indexed by dimension and codec-failed selective deletion, retained repeat-use route plus physical-stack mana payment; distinct from relay-mounted in-flight passenger entity, world block pad route or global world directory. Requires independent semantic confirmation, not automatic ID/fingerprint uniqueness credit.
dedup_review.comparison_read: Read existing explicit review rows batch101 Luminizer, batch109 Cyclic pad and batch143 Waystones fields. No fresh whole-source reread of those prior chains claimed; existing accepted notes are comparison basis.
